```{r}
replay.fitting <- multiRL::rpl_e(
  result = fitting,

  data = data,
  behrule = behrule,
  colnames = colnames,
  
  models = list(multiRL::TD),
  # policy = "off" (Human)
  settings = list(name = c("TD"), policy = "off"),

  omit = c("funcs")
)

#save(replay.fitting, file = "../OUTPUT/replay.fitting.Human.Rdata")

```

```{r}
load("../OUTPUT/0_Human/replay.fitting.Human.Rdata")
```

```{r}
#load("../OUTPUT/replay.fitting.Human.Rdata")

data_fitting <- base::do.call(
  base::rbind,
  base::lapply(
    replay.fitting[[1]],
    function(subject) {
      subject[["multiRL.summary"]]@data
    }
  )
)

p <- extract_setsize_history(data_fitting)
plot_setsize_analysis(p)

ggplot2::ggsave(filename = "../SetSize_Effect_Human.png", width = 8, height = 6)
rm(p)
```

```{r}
data_fitting <- base::do.call(
  base::rbind,
  base::lapply(
    replay.fitting[[1]],
    function(subject) {
      subject[["multiRL.summary"]]@data
```
